description: Feature-dev declines to add a retry for an intermittent failure whose mechanism has not been observed, and proposes an observation instead.
failure_mode: Model adds a retry, a widened timeout, or added tolerance for a failure nobody has watched happen — the shape that shipped a magic-link redelivery retry which would have re-hidden the real bug the moment it was fixed.
prompt: An integration test in this repo fails roughly one run in five. Nobody has captured a failing run's state. A reviewer suggests wrapping the flaky step in a 3-attempt retry with a 25-second backoff, describing it as diagnostic rather than a fix. Do you add it? Say what you do instead.
